```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(fpp3)
```


```{r}
aus_gas <- aus_production

aus_gas |>
    autoplot(Gas)
```

## Train/test split

```{r}
h <- 12
aus_gas_train <- 
    aus_gas |>
    slice_head(n = nrow(x = aus_gas) - h)
aus_gas_test <-
    aus_gas |>
    slice_tail(n = h)
```

## Model fitting


```{r}
aus_gas_fit <- aus_gas_train |>
    model(
        snaive = SNAIVE(log(Gas)),
        drift = RW(log(Gas) ~ drift())
    )
aus_gas_fit
```

## Residual diagnostics

```{r}
aus_gas_fit |>
    select(snaive) |>
    gg_tresiduals() +
    ggtitle("Diagnóstico de residuos de modelos SNAIVE")

aus_gas_fit |>
    select(drift) |>
    gg_tsresiduals() +
    ggtitle("Diagnóstico de residuos de modelo Drift")

```
